knowledge_gaps: The reported combined_score values lack category results, exact configurations, checkpoint provenance, and confirmation that they equal pinned macro validation HR@10. They cannot yet establish a controlled lexical improvement; the -1 result also needs a recorded failure reason.

Reproduction still requires the supplied baseline integration details, exact tokenizer, permitted catalog scope, item-to-metadata mapping, optimizer parameter groups, and checkpoint-selection rule. These require host information rather than web search.

Mean pooling loses within-field word order and relationships between numbers, units, and products. Preserving identifier tokens alone does not establish that the encoder can distinguish the functional differences motivating the proposal.

Norm matching bounds residual magnitude but can amplify gradients near zero projected norms. The report needs measured lexical gradient norms, residual-to-identity norms, training throughput, and peak memory before its compute feasibility is established.

Semantic attribution remains unresolved without matched retraining controls. Specify text shuffling within training-frequency and missingness strata, paired validation uncertainty, and adaptive-selection caveats. Every control must retain one independently trained HSTU per category without combining predictions.

Originality 3 is reasonable. Potential 7 remains a hypothesis; difficulty 5 is provisional until baseline integration and full-catalog scoring costs are measured. Keep objective and temporal changes as subsequent alternatives.
